summary: Positions 150-299 (sheets 18-37): 150 entries = 64 photo, 76 skip, 10 unsure. PHOTO: 46 worth keeping, 18 wrong keeps (all revival-style theatres, libraries, houses and offices kept on the architect-on-wall test; plus Flora Lamson Hewlett Library, whose Kahn credit is impossible for 1981, and the Augsburg seminary whose lead is institutional history); 12 field fixes (3 names to the Wikipedia title, 4 by, 1 year, 1 features, 2 movements, 1 concept); 9 main-photo flags (5 with a better file: Jingliao, Primavesi, Sowden, Olympia Miami, Rundkino; Lescaze low priority; 3 borderline with none: Majestic, Naturtheater, Ormen Lange). Weakest keeps: Aon Center, Olympia Miami, Joseph H. Brown School, Hiroshima ICC, Nijmegen theatre, Majestic Theatre (kept for a first/record/named-style claim). Doubtful year, left as prep: Gebouw A Radio Kootwijk 1919 (lead gives no completion date and 1919 is probably a start). No duplicates of wall buildings: the dup flags in range (Exxon Bldg, 33 Thomas, Hiroshima ICC, Rundkino, Moore House) are neighbours only; qid, id and 250 m coordinate checks found none; the nine must-skip positions are all below 150. All types, movements and concepts are in vocab.json, all photo files and licences match prep.json. SKIP/UNSURE: 4 rescued (Schönberg Tower and Versöhnungskirche Ulm moderate, Dominus Flevit moderate, Crater Lake Superintendent's Residence low, b/w photo); every other skip stands. Unsure stay out for want of a usable main photo: Allen Frank House (no photos), Kansas City Power and Light (only night/skyline/detail), Buckingham Building, San Gabriele Milan (drawings, one exterior with trucks), Mercado de las Carnes (no photos), Cordoba Chamber of Commerce (plans only), Kulturzentrum Mattersburg (2021 glass rebuild), 250 Vesey (complex only); Droste-Hülshoff Freiburg and Klingenmuseum Solingen have impossible architect dates and no design reason. Empty-lead skips that would be strong with a lead (left skipped per the rule): AEG-Hochspannungsfabrik (Behrens), Poelzig Building, Casa Caccia (Botta), La Scala La Chaux-de-Fonds (Le Corbusier), Villa Jaquemet and Villa Stotzer (Le Corbusier), Haus Perls (Mies), Wagenaarweg 30 (van de Velde), Oud's Hoek van Holland housing, Mallet-Stevens villas (Augier-Prouvost, Trapenard, Collinet), Jacobsen's own house, Haus Duldeck (Steiner), Quartiere Mangiagalli II and INA Cesate (no photos). Other near-misses left skipped: deSingel (main photo shows a later timber block, the Stynen building only at distance), Xewkija Rotunda, Neuerdberg and Maria Königin des Friedens (lead gives nothing on design), Strusshamn Church, St. Augustinus Düsseldorf, St. Paulus Beuel (Dominikus Böhm died 1955, before the 1956-58 build).
